summary: Completed frontend-only E2E testing of Clarity Prioritise SPA at https://prioritise-app.preview.emergentagent.com/. All 15 required flows verified: seed RICE board loads with 5 items, theme toggle persists to localStorage, RICE add/score/sort works (score formula verified 8000*2*0.8/3=4267), Kano board creates with 5 categorized columns and category select works, Value vs Effort board renders SVG scatter with points, export downloads file starting with 'clarity-', import adds '(imported)' board, data persists across reloads, delete-all-boards restores a seed board, /about page shows storage key 'clarity-prioritise:v1', mobile drawer opens via topbar menu.
observations: External network: app itself makes NO external HTTP requests from its own code. Google Fonts link was correctly removed from index.html. The only non-same-origin request observed is https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js, which is auto-injected by Cloudflare at the edge (not referenced in app source). This is platform-level and not introduced by app code. PostHog + emergent-main.js are platform-added as allowed by the problem statement.
uid format contains a hyphen (e.g. 'abc123-def456') so data-testid values like 'rice-row-<id>' contain 4 dash-separated segments; any test scripts splitting by '-' must account for this.
verified_flows: Seed RICE board 'Q2 Roadmap Draft' with 5 items loads on first visit
Sidebar 'New board' dialog creates Kano board with 5 category columns + descriptions
Value vs Effort board shows custom SVG ve-chart and sorted table; ve-point-<id> renders
RICE add form inserts new row (5->6); rice-sort-<col> toggles; riceScore = (reach*impact*confidence/100)/effort verified
Kano category dropdown on add-form places item in correct column (delighter)
Import via sidebar-import-input adds new board with name suffix '(imported)'
Theme toggle adds/removes 'dark' class on <html> and persists to localStorage 'clarity-prioritise:theme'
State persists across reload in localStorage 'clarity-prioritise:v1'
Deleting all boards triggers fresh seed board restoration
/about route renders About page mentioning 'clarity-prioritise:v1' storage key
Mobile (390px): topbar-mobile shown, topbar-mobile-menu opens sidebar-mobile-drawer
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: in storage.js addItem, partial is spread AFTER defaultItemForFramework, which means partial from caller correctly overrides defaults - OK. But note that partial.title/description are re-spread via '...partial' after the trimmed versions, so raw (untrimmed) values in partial would override the trimmed 'title'. Currently not an issue because callers pre-trim, but worth tightening.
Minor: importBoardFromJson does not validate framework value against FRAMEWORKS whitelist; a file with a random framework string would still import and then render nothing.
seed_data_creation: None - app seeds itself on first load via localStorage
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is pure client-side SPA; no backend. Start by clearing localStorage if you want a clean seed. All data-testid conventions from the spec match implementation. uid() produces IDs containing a hyphen, so do not split data-testid by '-' to count rows - use CSS ancestor selectors like '[data-testid="rice-table"] tbody tr' instead.
